name: Nextcloud
summary: Files, calendars and contacts for a team.
description: Nextcloud keeps the files, calendars and contacts of a team on its own server, with apps for the desktop and the phone. For teams that want their own cloud storage.
licence_note: Free to self-host. If you change its code and offer it as a service, you must share your changes.
whats_new: The first version of the template.
first_steps: Sign in as admin with the password in the environment variable ADMIN_PASSWORD (Environment, Reveal). The first start installs Nextcloud and takes a few minutes. Change the password in Nextcloud: a change of the variable later does not change it. When you add your own domain, add it to the trusted domains of Nextcloud too.
